Woodrush Luzula sp. * The terms “tundra grizzly” and “barren-ground grizzly” are used interchangeably to refer to a grizzly bear ( Ursus arctos ) living in such habitat. ** American marine biologists have recently begun to use “belukha” to distinguish the white whale ( Delphinapterus leucas ). In Russian “beluga” refers to the white sturgeon ( Acipenser huso ).
